registration: data/b266_registration_2026-08-31.txt -- b266, THE STATE OF THE SHADOW

clauses.clause: ten owning files must exist to quote from
clauses.from: the fold quotes obstacles from b256..b265; a fold registered against files that are not on disk would be unsatisfiable in exactly the sense b264's clause (I) was. Counted by listing data/b25[6-9]_*.txt and data/b26[0-5]_*.txt banks.
NO numerical computation is performed. The act reads ten text files, writes four, and runs the gate suite; measured comparable acts (b256's fold) cost under a minute.
the largest file this act reads whole is PLACE-papers/FINDINGS.md at ~1.1 MB; no array is allocated at all

b257 scoped TECHNE-Core local-only and its modules/ is untracked; clause (J.7) forbids a push and this act plans none. A NONZERO demand here would be a contradiction with (J.7), not a resource problem.

clauses.clause: lean files this act may move
clauses.from: F-NOSHADOW: the ferry orders filings only and no new mathematics, so no .lean file is created or edited

clauses.clause: existing FINDINGS.md lines this act may delete or retag
clauses.from: F-NOGRADE: the change to FINDINGS.md must be PURELY ADDITIVE, checked by diff against HEAD
